::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 19th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 38-39
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

It is an odd doubt, but I am not sure whether it was you or [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd) who wrote to me about writing a History to suit that proof. Am I to understand that I may take [the wars](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) of the Castilhians [sic] and Moors, for I should like to make it my winter work

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
